description: WS6.1 skills — SECONDARY measurement. Phrase (general capability) vs keyword (named tool) — the category_instance relation written the way a vacancy might actually phrase a requirement in free text, rather than as a short skills[]-style keyword. This is informational only: it documents the category-to-instance / directionality limitation named in 5.4 (a vacancy asking for the general capability, matched by a CV naming the specific tool, is correct; the reverse is not, and cosine similarity is symmetric so it cannot enforce that direction). It does NOT feed SKILL_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD -- calibrate-thresholds.mjs reports whether each pair clears the PRIMARY threshold (from skills-pairs.json) purely as an illustration, never as its own derivation. This is the same pair set that produced skills' v2 100% false-negative result -- kept, not deleted, per the instruction to preserve every result set as evidence.
